CORE COMPETENCIES
Methodologies: Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, BDD, Requirements Lifecycle Management, Change Management Domain Expertise: Digital Transformation, SWIFT Payments (MT/ISO 20022), Transaction Monitoring (AML), ELT Data Sourcing, Capital Markets Tools & Tech: JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Excel, draw.io, ServiceNow, GCP, Oracle, MS SQL
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
CGI | Lead Business Analyst
Aug 2021 – Present | Pune, India
Client: AS Watson (Digital Transformation – Retail Mobility)
Mobile App Development: Spearheaded business analysis and requirement engineering for a store-employee-
facing mobile application designed to digitize retail operations.
Process Automation: Maintained end-to-end responsibility for features enabling real-time wireless printing of
shelf edge labels directly from the shop floor, streamlining store inventory management.
Client: Deutsche Bank (Transaction Monitoring & Service Automation)


ELT Data Pipeline Delivery: Acted as the Lead BA within the core Transaction Monitoring Data team, managing complex ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) logic to source, validate, and feed clean financial data into AML and sanctions screening applications. Service Automation: Directed business analysis for service automation workflows across multiple key digital transformation initiatives, cutting operational overhead.
Compliance Optimization: Refined alert segmentation rules, reducing false-positive rates by ~20% and
improving overall investigative workflow efficiency.
Client: CIBC (Payments Modernization)
Payments Engine Implementation: Led business analysis for a high-volume central payments engine
responsible for processing all inbound and outbound financial messaging across the bank and its global subsidiaries.

SWIFT & ISO 20022 Migration: Mapped complex legacy MT message flows (MT103, MT202, MT202 COV) to modern ISO 20022 XML formats, increasing Straight Through Processing (STP) rates and decreasing manual interventions by 30%.
Agile Leadership: Functioned as Agile BA and Project Lead—facilitating sprint ceremonies, managing product
backlogs, and leading cross-functional coordination across regions.
Cognizant | Associate Business Analyst
Aug 2018 – Aug 2021 | Pune, India
Data Migration: Served as Lead Business Analyst for data migration projects, smoothly transitioning legacy
asset reconciliation systems to Gresham CTC with zero production downtime.
Data Mapping & Rules: Authored extensive target data mappings, complex validation logic, build reconciliation
rules to ensure high-fidelity financial reporting.
Technical Optimization: Developed and optimized SQL scripts to accelerate reconciliation speed and ensure full
compliance documentation (traceability matrices, audit trails).
FIS Global | Senior Software Engineer
Apr 2014 – Aug 2018 | Pune, India
Project: Securities 360
Client Services Engineering: Handled core software development and production support within the client
services team for a major Capital Markets platform.
Domain Mastery: Gained deep technical and functional knowledge of the end-to-end trade lifecycle, covering
trade capture, post-trade asset processing, settlement, and reconciliation.
Collaborative Delivery: Partnered closely with consulting business analysts and global banking clients to design
and deploy platform enhancements aligned with regulatory standards.
